comment: Grants every contained harness receives, whatever its profile. Required entries must exist; an absent optional entry is reported as omitted. Paths are resolved (symlinks followed) and pinned before a rule is installed.

paths.reason: system runtime: shared libraries, the dynamic loader, interpreters and the tools harnesses run
system binaries on hosts where /bin is a real directory, not a merged-/usr link
system binaries on hosts where /sbin is a real directory, not a merged-/usr link
shared libraries on hosts where /lib is a real directory, not a merged-/usr link
the x86-64 dynamic loader on hosts where /lib64 is a real directory, not a merged-/usr link

runtime introspection: claude reads /proc/self/maps, statm and cgroup and /proc/stat at startup and aborts without them, and tools need it; /proc/self differs per process, so it cannot be granted more narrowly
user and home-directory lookups
group lookups
static name resolution, including localhost

TLS trust store (Fedora and RHEL layout)
system-wide TLS policy that OpenSSL reads on Fedora-family hosts
DNS resolver configuration; the systemd-resolved socket is denied, so glibc falls back to DNS over UDP port 53. Absent (or a dangling link) in some VM guests
name-service switch for glibc lookups; absent on musl hosts
resolver options read by glibc
getaddrinfo address-sorting policy
the dynamic loader's library cache; loading still works without it, only slower
local time zone for timestamps
distribution identification (claude and codex report it)

system git configuration
system git attributes

login-shell setup fragments (as /etc/profile)

interactive bash setup (Debian and Ubuntu layout)
readline key bindings
